faqs.question: Is the BTech Mechanical Engineering syllabus the same for all colleges?
faqs.answer: The BTech Mechanical Engineering syllabus is not the same across all colleges, as every college committee sets a particular coursework pattern at the start of every academic year to be followed for the respective batch. The syllabus includes some core subjects, interesting electives, and lab work that gives detailed knowledge to the students about the workings of the field.

faqs.question: Does BTech Civil Engineering syllabus focus more on theory or practical application?
faqs.answer:
The BTech Civil Engineering syllabus focuses on both theoretical lectures as well as practical work.
With the help of lectures in the curriculum, theoretical concepts are introduced to students, tutorials provide space for solving problems and applications also.
And the labs offer hands-on experience to students who get acquainted with equipment and CAD software. Also, the field projects also allow students to apply their B Tech Civil Engg. skills and knowledge to design and implement communication systems.

faqs.question: Do colleges provide campus placements for BTech ECE graduates?
faqs.answer: Yes, of course. Top colleges do offer placements to BTech ECE graduates in the final year of their academic journey, with top recruiting companies visiting the college campuses through placement drives and the annual placement fair to hire students with the right skill set, passion, and spark to excel in the field and assist them in driving growth and profitability for their business.

A:    Srikalahasteeswara Institute of Technology provides programmes including UG Diploma, B.E. / B.Tech, MBA/PGDM, M.E./M.Tech in streams such as Engineering, Business & Management Studies, and are excellent for students to build their careers. The institute has specializations in Civil Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Mechanical Engineering.

reviews.review_heading: I am not much satisfied with the college. I don't recommend anyone to join in the college.

reviews.review_heading: I recommend not to join in this college. Now this college is at the verge of extension.

reviews.review_heading: 2012-2016, journey of a great institute to a worse one.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure but completely negligible maintenance.only for visual not practical.Most of the labs will be fully equipped with old equipments which we can't use practically. Not at all worth the fee we pay for it. Administration don't even take any ones suggestions.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with college management, placements.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available at college. Classrooms are good. Library is good there are lot of books n library but they didn't gave to home more than 3 books. If we keep the 3 books more than week we want to pay the fine. Every week we want to renewal the books. Medical facilities are bad. Sports & games is too the worst. There is no encouragement for sports. Labs are good. Canteen food is waste of money. I faced major problem with library they didn't give more than 3 books how can we study for semister e...

reviews.review_heading: Complete negligence of our principal we lost our placements in 2016 batch.
reviews.review_text: No Wi-Fi, library was good, classrooms are spacial and no medical facilities. Labs also good. When come to matter of sports and games cricket was only game I play most. Canteen food was just okay. And hostel rooms are old college campus classrooms. Finally Campus was good and facilities are not good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the infrastructure of our college is good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is really good, and the labs are super. We have a good infrastructure in the college like many other colleges of JNTU. Coming to the infrastructure, it is good and well-equipped. The infrastructure is really good and nice.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, our college is very good for the placements.
reviews.review_text: In our college, the labs are very good and have good equipment because previously there was JNTU inspection, and in that inspection, people also said these are one of the best labs in Anantapur. The books related to every semester and textbooks of many authors are available in the library. Textbooks are the minimum things in any college, but our college also provides current affairs books, and some novel stories books because many students are interested in current affairs and also in novels. Ma...

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied due to lack of the faculty members and the equipment in the laboratories.
reviews.review_text: Up to 2015, the infrastructure is bad, but recently, it has been modified and now it is well-constructed. The Wi-Fi facility is not available but has the facility of LAN connection. The library is good, but sometimes you will get the shortage of books. There are no medical facilities on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: The review of Intell Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: Intell Engineering College provides the great infrastructure creating a healthy environment for study. The whole campus is entirely Wi-Fi enabled. The seminar halls and the classrooms use the projectors for the visual aid. The canteen is good and provides the quality food.

reviews.review_heading: Top college from back list.
reviews.review_text: Well, the entire infrastructure of the college is good, no doubt in that, but there is a huge lack of the faculty. The college is losing students with lack of the faculty. The college, no games are conducted the playground exists there itself. The digital classes and seminar rooms are available but are not using well. The college failed in conducting fests also.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied with the faculty members and the placements.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms, the lab equipment, and the library are good. The college has a space for ground, but it is not good for playing the games. The Wi-Fi facility is not good at all, and they are using the Jio Wi-Fi. The college atmosphere is good, and they have all the labs equipment. The canteen is not at all good. There is a rule that all the students are must travel in their buses only. Overall, the infrastructure is satisfactory. Don't expect too much about the college as it is a normal college.

reviews.review_heading: They don't care about the students life with their negligence.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is nice, and it was near to the city. They provide bus facility from all the corners of the city and nearby mandals. Poor sports contributions and events. Rare cases of NCC. The infrastructure is well built recently. But they didn't provide the professional faculty.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Engineering - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied due to lack of teaching staff.

content.Placements: More than 30% were placed and the highest salary offered was of 3 Lacs per annum. More than 60% students got internship in our course in many of the companies and most of the students got placed in big basket, Amazon, and one out classmate got appointed in TATA.
content.Infrastructure: There is no Wi-Fi in our college classrooms somewhat better and we don't even have proper equipment in lab and the students are not Allowed to do practicals. Coming to the facilities in our hostel it was waste of all your money, the food was very stale and unclean.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: This is an average rated college.

content.Placements: The placements in the college are good. Last year, around 35% of the students got placed on the campus placements. The highest salary package offered was Rs. 40,000 per month, the lowest was Rs. 8,000 per month and the average was Rs. 15,000 per month. Not all but some companies visited the campus for placements. They offered software designer, analyser, etc., roles to placed students. Of course, there is a placement cell in our college, and it is good.
content.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi facility and labs are good. The computer lab is well-built, chemistry lab is smelly, physics lab is always empty, and communication lab is free as we can use it at any time. First desk is very good and hard. As how hard we shake it remains stay and calm like a bomb.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: More future and bright future with Gandhiji institute of Science technology.

content.Placements: GIST provides more than ten placements for every stream in B.Tech and M.Tech. Many companies visited the college and took the students with placements opportunity with a huge salary, and Gandhiji Institute of Science and Technology has the very experienced faculty with high qualifications, and the management is very sincere to make decisions about the placements.
content.Infrastructure: Gandhiji Institute of Science and Technology affiliated to Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University and is located near Jaggaiahpeta, Krishna district, Andhra Pradesh. It has a great infrastructure, and it has individual classes for every stream. GIST college is having B.Tech, M.Tech, and also MBA.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied with the college environment and the faculty.

content.Placements: There is no question of placements in this college, especially for the mechanical engineering department, but for the other branches, some companies have been recruited a few students that too with a low package. The training has to improve in the institute.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure on the campus was average and need to improve. The labs in the department of mechanical engineering were not good, and we can't observe the fully equipped machines and instruments in the lab. It has to improve in this department of mechanical engineering.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely dissatisfied because of placements.

content.Placements: During the period of our seniors, they had a quite good number of placements. Later on during our final year, the number of placements reduced. During our time, most of the companies in campus placement drive are BPO companies with less than 1,80,000 per year.
content.Infrastructure: Our college had a good infrastructure with quite good number of computers in computer lab, and highly equipped machine labs, circuit labs and well designed exam halls. Good hostel and canteen facility are available. College's main building is constructed in square shape so that each corner is visible from the principal room.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Technology Research and Integrated Institute.
reviews.review_text: The college building is big enough to be a good college. There are big labs, lecture halls, and the library is also good. But the building is old and has not been maintained properly. ACs are not working in labs and the library, and the water supply is also not very good. Toilets are absolutely trash. The hostel rooms are good and clean, but bathrooms are not clean, and washbasins are also dirty. The water cooler is not working, the Wi-Fi is not working, the gym is old, and the mess food is of v...

reviews.review_heading: College and hostel are away from home.
reviews.review_text: The whole college has Wi-Fi coverage but in the hostel, the range can vary. The whole campus is fully air-conditioned and campus area is digital. Classrooms are also air-conditioned and digital like smart boards, projectors, and digital environment. The infrastructure of hostel and college is very good. Nice buildings and proper space for park and playgrounds for cricket and football and indoor games. Hostel fees is Rs. 39,500 per semester in which the rooms, electricity, mess, medical facilitie...

reviews.review_heading: Review of Technology Education and Research Integrated Institution.
reviews.review_text: The hostel provides every facility for students, like separate beds and cupboards with the best infrastructure. Wi-Fi facility is provided for students with good speed and unlimited data. The mess staff are good. Fresh and hygienic food is served to students.

reviews.review_heading: It has really good infrastructure and facilities. The quality of food in the mess is not very well.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are very well here. Wi-Fi is always activated here, and labs are always in working condition. Classrooms are always clean. The library is always open for everyone during college time and is always clean. Facilities provided in the hostel are very well, but one thing is that the quality of food served in the mess is not very well. Medical facilities are not available here. Sports and games are always organised here every year in February as sports meet.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely good college if you want to learn something.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of institution is pretty good. There are 3 grounds for playing. It has spacious classrooms as well as multiple workshops and laboratories for students. There is a compter lab which has more than 500 laptops for students and Wi-Fi coverage all over the campus. Talking about hostel, it is good enough to stay. All the basic facilities are available. Food is good most of the times but sometimes it's average. There are equipments and courts for every game that is played generally.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, decent fees, and far from the city. It is the best place for self-development.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and Wi-Fi services are good. Labs are equipped with computers with full 24x7 internet service. The library is also good with fans, no air-conditioner, and they only boast about it. The library is also open at night. The hostel food is fine. The rate of the hostel is ordinary, and the food they offer is good and efficient at that rate.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best campus with good infrastructure and labs.
reviews.review_text: The campus is spread in more than 20 acres, and it is 9 km far from Kurukshetra city. The whole campus was Wi-Fi supportive. There are separate laptop, labs for each course and a common library. Seminar rooms for each department were also available. There was a separate hostel for boys and girls with separate gyms and a common mess. Grounds are also available for volleyball, basketball, football. A doctor is always available on the campus for providing medical help.

reviews.review_heading: The college offers you the best with the lowest fee structure.
reviews.review_text: The college is completely furnished with all the basic and ultra-modern amenities required by the students for the development. The college provides facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, advanced classrooms and library. The library not only works in the regular hours but also in night time. Quality of food served in the mess and cafeteria is good. Although all the students have different taste, if we talk about nutrition values, then it is the best.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing place for jobs. Terii college! A place where you get known for!
reviews.review_text:
Books are available for every class
Good wifi almost 6 wifis just inside the campus
Hostel accomodation was amazing with wifi available 24/7 with bathrooms in every floor and hygienic 
Libraries are open for anyone who wants to read books or just chill

reviews.review_heading: Review of Technology Education and Research Integrated Institution.
reviews.review_text: Laboratories are very good. Our campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Classrooms are well-maintained. There is a decent library but few books are available. Hostel facilities are not good. The food quality is average. Medical facilities are not available for emergency purposes. Playground is available for sports like cricket.

reviews.review_heading: This college is a money-making scheme by hook or by crook.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are non-stable in this college. No teachers are permanent expect 3-4. They charge for Wi-Fi which is almost dead speed. Once we got a lizard in our hostel lunch. So the quality of food is also 3rd class. But sometimes we get time for playing games.

reviews.review_heading: We are satisfied with good placements, infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is good. All classrooms are air-conditioned, and teachers conduct class through a projector. Hostel service is excellent, and food quality is good at a lower cost.

reviews.review_heading: The best college for management studies. The course is very well designed.
reviews.review_text: Focus on learning edge platform, very responsive throughout the year, drive continuous improvement through our well-equipped computer labs with wi-fi facility. There is a library facility and smart classrooms where you can spend your precious hours for studying. Playgrounds for playing basketballs. The hostel rooms are available in twin sharing and the quality of food provided in the mess are good.

faqs.answer:
A:    Universal College of Engineering and Technology has below criteria for taking admissions to it's various courses: CoursesEligibilityB.E. / B.TechCandidate must have passed VIII, IX, X, XI & XII Std. from schools situated in Tamil Nadu.
Tamil Nadu native candidate who have passed any of the VIII, IX, X, XI & XII Std. or their equivalent exam from schools situated outside Tamil Nadu can also apply. They should produce Original Nativity Certificate.
Children of Central Government Employees, irrespective of their nativity, provided their parents or guardians (only if both parents are not alive) have been serving in Tamil Nadu continuously for the past five years can be eligible to apply.
Sons & daughters of All India service Tamil Nadu cadre officers are eligible to apply. A Self declaration from the parent in this regard is to be produced.
Children of employees in the Public Sector or Government recognised institutions had been working in their organisations for the past five years are also eligible, irrespective of their domicile.
Other State candidates who have studied VIII, IX, X, XI and XII Std. in Tamil Nadu are eligible to apply.M.E./M.TechCandidate who have completed 10+2+AMIE or 10+3 years Diploma + AMIE are also eligible.
AMIE candidate must have 2 years regular full time experience in the relevant field.
